beats.speech: Stop saying very sick. Here are three better words.

card.headline: Feverish
card.use: Leo wakes up hot and shaky.

beats.speech: Feverish: Leo wakes up hot and shaky. He feels feverish.

card.headline: Bedridden
card.use: Soon he can't even stand up.

beats.speech: Bedridden: Soon he can't even stand up. He's bedridden for days.

card.headline: Seriously ill
card.use: A week later, he's back at school!

beats.speech: Seriously ill: A week later, he's back at school! He was seriously ill.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!
